name: Marsberg (Germany)
description: Yellow field with narrow red and yellow stripes along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the city arms of Marsberg (a yellow letter A on red).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg of 24 March 1977 the city of Marsberg was granted the right to bear arms, a seal and a banner; the arms continue those granted to Obermarsberg by the King of Prussia on 20 December 1909, the letter A going back to coins struck in the town since the 13th century.

features.role: Marsberg arms — yellow letter A on red
